scenes.headline: How mixture-of-experts models fit in 1.5 bits per weight
scenes.sub: Codecs are chosen offline. Which experts stay in memory changes as it runs.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marlin! Here's how a mixture of experts model gets to one and a half bits per weight.

scenes.text: Spend one byte budget on two axes, precision per layer and experts kept per layer, then keep swapping which experts are resident.
scenes.mark: keep swapping which experts are resident
scenes.say: One memory budget, two axes: how precisely each layer is stored, and how many experts stay in memory. Then keep swapping which ones.

scenes.title: Iterative sensitivity probing
scenes.say: Offline first. Below two bits, layer costs stop adding up, so they're measured under real compression.

items.say: Probe the uncompressed model. Only the fragile layers show.
Change one layer, keep the rest, measure perplexity.
Price every byte the same, and let each layer pick its cheapest setting.

items.text: Probe again under the new compression
items.say: Probe again under that compression, and repeat until nothing moves.

scenes.title: Which experts stay, decided while it runs

steps.say: Each layer keeps a fixed number of experts in memory. The rest are masked out.
But the router still scores every expert, and two running averages rank them.

steps.note: no swap unless four pairs qualify
steps.say: Every two hundred fifty six tokens, if four outsiders clearly beat insiders, they trade places.
The new experts load from memory or disk in the background. No token waits.

steps.note: static: 0.9% on Chinese, calibrated on code
steps.say: Frozen on code, a static set catches under one percent of the routing on Chinese text.
The swapping set stays above ninety two percent on every pair.

scenes.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: bits for the same perplexity
scenes.note: Unsloth's smallest checkpoint, read off the paper's plot
scenes.say: Against Unsloth's smallest checkpoint of this model, matching its perplexity takes almost nine tenths of a bit less.

scenes.label: saved against Unsloth at equal perplexity, across every plotted checkpoint
scenes.say: Across all the plotted checkpoints, the saving is a tenth of a bit to nine tenths, counting only experts in memory.

scenes.text: Price each layer under the compression you will ship, and let the router decide which experts stay in memory.

recap: Codecs and expert counts are fixed offline
Each layer is probed under the current compression
scenes.say: To recap: bit widths set offline, and the router keeps choosing which experts stay in memory.
